thought.text: Let me wait for these to progress.

reasoning_content: Let's wait a bit. pnpm install is running, and cargo install is also compiling. Let's wait a while and then check again. Let's use a sleep that can check the status.

action.command: sleep 90; echo "=== pulls ==="; tail -10 /tmp/pulls.log; echo; echo "=== pnpm ==="; tail -4 /tmp/pnpm-install.log; echo; echo "=== cargo procs ==="; ps aux | grep "cargo install" | grep -v grep | wc -l; echo "=== cargo logs tail ==="; for p in wasm-pack bacon sqlx-cli; do echo "-- $p --"; tail -2 /tmp/$p-install.log; done
